claim: Where four campaign maps cut a floor only to change its light, the step across the seam is 10 to 14.5 shades (E1M4 10, E3M1 12, E3M2 14, E3M5 14.5); smaller steps vanish in Blood's dark, contrasty textures (facade tiles have texel spreads of 12 to 34 at shade 0).
evidence: bloodmap/light_stage.py:592-598 (FLOOR_BAND 12, from work/lightstage/budget.py) and :883-887 (WALL_BAND 14: on a textured wall a step under ~10 does not show); facade texel spread from bloodmap/shade_table.py, 2026-11-20
The owner, 2026-11-20: the usable range is roughly 0 to 40, and 40 is visibly dark.
an agent's note of 2026-11-21 that E3M1 has 41% of its room floor inside lamp pools is not re-measured
use: Cut light pieces only where the step is at least ~10 shades; lowering base light alone only darkens, contrast needs falloff from sources.
